QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Kaptafel
QuestInfo.0: Chief Kan visits you to express his gratitude for all your help.
QuestInfo.1: Cayne introduces himself as a knight and Alika as a scholar who were both dispatched from Afinas to investigate the raging monsters in Abrup. A massive amount of people disappeared from Kaptafel about six months ago. If that's when the old woman's granddaughter disappeared, there might be a connection.
QuestInfo.2: After Cayne and Alika introduced themselves, you learned there might be a connection between the disappearances in Kaptafel and Abrup. You should do some more investigating.
